layout.note: the Bay's one sorting table (bay-design-1 design.md 2; bay-ui-2 spec.md): a code-drawn ledge, table and stores on the stage's field ground; the pictures are the signed crate, pod and supply masters placed 1:1

status: The Bay (bay-build-2): the dock ledge (the Companion in its cradle, its state, the crates that crossed and wait), the table (the crate in hand, sealed then open), the stores (the Nursery's shelf and the three counters). Two forms of one screen: the narrow form (530 x 600 lp, the phone's window) and the wide form (1024 x 600, the device). Every number is a starting value of bay-ui-2's spec; every word is bay-words-1's.
note: Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen lp. The top bar (0..40) and the bottom line (562..600) are the frame's. Pictures are placed 1:1; a dashed outline is a named slot for art not yet placed (rule 3): the cradle with the Companion (art piece 2) and the open crate (art piece 1), listed under [art] in the job's report.
stateRule: bay: the crates that crossed at the dock wait sealed: the first on the table, up to two on the ledge. ✓ opens the crate in hand (the table shows what it holds), ✓ again puts it away (pods to the Nursery's shelf, supplies to their counters) and the next crate comes down; ▼ puts away every crate that waits; the end says the sum and ✓ goes to the Nursery. ← at any time is Home (an open crate is put away first).

conditions.away: the cradle stands empty; crates that crossed still wait at the Bay
conditions.docked: the Companion sits in its cradle; its state is the ledge's two lines

focus.room: the ring on nothing: the Bay has no targets; ✓ does the bottom line's action, ▼ (the pad down) puts every crate away, the rest of the pad does nothing

confirm.bay: a crate waits: Open the crate; the crate in hand is open: Put away; nothing waits and crates were unloaded this visit: To the Nursery; else, when a pod waits on the mat, Look at the pods; else nothing

keys.all: the pad down while a crate waits: every crate that waits opens and is put away; the table then says the sum
keys.back: Home, the ring on the Bay module; an open crate is put away at once; crates not opened stay sealed
keys.dock: the Caddy's Dock, a world event, never a Station key: docked, the crates cross (the rule) and the Bay shows

end.action: strings.toNursery (the portrait first when a sitting crate was opened: strings.end.confirm)
